summary: Recursively/non-recursively copy paths with Node cpSync options when no dynamic filter callback is supplied.

semantics.options: force, errorOnExist, preserveTimestamps, dereference, verbatimSymlinks are semantically significant

caveats: Directory-copy defaults are not equivalent to a generic recursive Directory copy helper.
Symlink dereference/verbatim behavior must match options.
Timestamp preservation has filesystem precision/platform limits.

tests.name: recursive directory copy
tests.expected_behavior: copies the directory tree according to Node cpSync recursive semantics

tests.name: nonrecursive directory rejects
tests.expected_behavior: a directory source is not silently recursively copied when recursive is false
